name: Koyamada-SBRC
definition: A hybrid method blending Koyamada’s and SBRC algorithms. It uses Koyamada’s algorithm when the cost of using SBRC (cell activation overhead) is higher than the benefit of image-space coherency, particularly for cells with small projection areas.
summary: Koyamada-SBRC is a hybrid volume rendering algorithm that dynamically selects between Koyamada's and SBRC methods per cell to minimize computational cost.
